title: The Sync to live result never says the live site was not changed while writes went unanswered
steps: Run the publish-push-dom case for #286 (real PublishWizard in jsdom): all writes unknown; unknown plus refused; written plus unknown; nothing unknown; a failed apply with one write on the way.
expect: No nothing-sent notice when any write is unknown; the unknown notice says the live site may have changed; written plus unknown is a warning naming them; a failed apply lists the unknown write.
evidence: Issue #286: headline Nothing was sent | Your live site was not changed above May already be on your live site (1)

tests: writes sent with no answer back are never
